topic: Real RC fixed-wing failure modes, recovery reports and incidence evidence for the emergency-training failure library (EM-00-R1)
note: Guide: docs/research/failure-mode/EM-00-R1/README.md. New local copies in the gitignored references/failure-mode/; other paths are existing local reference copies reused unchanged. Web-only sources are under links. R-numbers continue EM-00 (R01-R16). Evidence: M official, R report, F forum/single video, E estimate.

files.title: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Roadmap 2002-2027
files.publisher: Office of the Secretary of Defense (AT&L), hosted by NASA Dryden
files.license: US Government work; reference copy kept local.
files.use: Section 5.2, printed pp.48-51, Fig. 5.2-2 extracted from OSD 2003 UAV Reliability Study: Power/Prop 37 %, Flight Control 26 %, Comm 11 %, Human/Ground 17 %, Misc 9 % of combined Predator/Pioneer/Hunter mishaps (nearly 100,000 h, 36 combined years since 1986); Table 5.2-1 Class A rates.

files.title: A Post-Accident Analysis of Civil Remotely-Piloted Aircraft System Accidents and Incidents (doi 10.5028/jatm.v9i2.701)
files.publisher: Journal of Aerospace Technology and Management 9(2):157-168
files.license: Open-access journal article; check journal licence before any redistribution. Reference only; do not redistribute or commit.
files.use: 152 civil RPAS cases 2006-2015: SCF 63 %, LOC-I 14 %; equipment problems 41 % (64 % excl. unknown), human factors 15 % (23 %); cruise 45 %, takeoff 30 %, landing 25 %; about a third of equipment problems lost link (printed pp.161-165).
